title: British Institutions and the Media (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Odpowiedz na pytania (1.1.-1.5.) dotyczace wiedzy o krajach anglojezycznych. Odpowiadaj po angielsku. W pytaniach oznaczonych 2 pkt nalezy podac dwie informacje.

items.question: What do the letters BBC stand for?
What is the address of the official residence of the British Prime Minister?
What is the name of the elected house of the UK Parliament? What is the name of the other house?
Which British newspaper has the nickname 'The Thunderer'?
What is the name of the UK's public health service, founded in 1948?
